[ASSISTANT_SAID] Walt Disney World consists of four separate parks: Magic Kingdom, Epcot, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Orlando Resort includes Universal Studios Florida and Universal's Islands of Adventure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SeaWorld Orlando is described as a marine-life theme park with rollercoasters, water rides, and animal exhibits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] LEGOLAND Florida is designed for younger kids with rides, shows, and LEGO-themed fun.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended rollercoasters include SheiKra at Busch Gardens Tampa Bay, Mako, Kraken, and Manta at SeaWorld Orlando, Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit at Universal Studios Florida, Incredible Hulk Coaster at Universal's Islands of Adventure, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith at Walt Disney World's Hollywood Studios, and Expedition Everest - Legend of the Forbidden Mountain at Walt Disney World's Animal Kingdom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting include planning during the off-season, considering park-hopper tickets or annual passes, taking breaks, and not missing evening shows and fireworks displays.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Florida's HHN features unique original haunts, larger scale experiences, unique scare zones, and roaming hordes of scareactors.
